“If”

Had it not been for an “if” the old woman would have bitten a wolf.
Danish.
“If” is the only peace-maker.
Shakespeare.
Were it not for “if” and “but” we should all be rich forever.
French.
With the help of an “if” you might put Paris in a bottle.
French.
